items.title: Every Call Through Redpanda: The Contract Behind a School Platform
items.excerpt: The shared rules for the school management microservices: why Redpanda over plain Kafka, events versus request/reply, the 5-second reply timeout, and how topics are named.

items.title: ECS Fargate or EKS? Same App, Two Orchestrators
items.excerpt: What deploying one storefront both ways showed about setup effort, service discovery, load balancing and cost, and the rule of thumb for choosing between them.

items.title: Reading an Incident Report Written by the System Itself
items.excerpt: An automated root-cause report from the self-healing stack: a 65-second API error spike, the signals it ruled out, and the restart that ended it.

items.title: A Runbook for Restoring a Database in Another Region
items.excerpt: Step-by-step recovery of the FinCorp ledger from cross-region AWS Backup copies, with the targets that frame it: RTO of 30 minutes, RPO of up to a day.

items.title: Three Controls for an Immutable Supply Chain
items.excerpt: CodeArtifact as the single source for every package, ECR scanning with immutable tags, and a build that refuses to ship HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities.

items.title: Zombie Assets: What an Inherited AWS Account Was Paying For
items.excerpt: An idle, oversized instance, volumes attached to nothing and an orphaned Elastic IP: how to find them in Cost Explorer, what they cost, and how to stop them coming back.

items.title: Gating Every Deploy on Security Scans
items.excerpt: How the GitOps mail pipeline chains SonarQube, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy, Gitleaks and an SBOM into one gate that fails the build on any High or Critical finding.

items.title: Auditing an AI Hiring Model for Bias
